# Phillies 2025 roster

Several variables are hiding multiple pieces of information inside strings. Our job is to turn those strings into variables we can actually analyze.

## Learning Goals

-   identify columns that contain multiple values within one string
-   use `stringr` functions to inspect, detect, remove, and extract text
-   create cleaner variables from messy character columns
-   explain why cleaning choices matter for downstream analysis
